def get_neighbors(r, c):

    for dr in [-1, 0, 1]:

            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            if 0 <= nr < len(grid) and 0 <= nc < len(grid[0]):

def flood_fill(start):
    component = [start]
    queue = [start]
    visited.add(start)
    while queue:
        curr = queue.pop(0)
        for n in get_neighbors(*curr):
            if n not in visited:
                visited.add(n)
                component.append(n)
                queue.append(n)
    return component
